tasks.label: Nix Build (Debug)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake -G Ninja -B build-nix -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/nix-toolchain.cmake && cmake --build build-nix --parallel'
tasks.detail: Build using Nix flake environment and Nix toolchain for full isolation

tasks.label: Nix Build (CI Strictness)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake -G Ninja -B build-ci-strict -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/nix-toolchain.cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DENABLE_CI_STRICTNESS=ON && cmake --build build-ci-strict --parallel'
tasks.detail: Build with CI-level strictness (Release mode + extra error flags) to catch issues before CI

tasks.label: Nix Build (GCC Linux-like)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'CC=gcc CXX=g++ cmake -G Ninja -B build-gcc-strict -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/nix-toolchain.cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-Wall -Wextra -Werror=unused-result" && cmake --build build-gcc-strict --parallel'
tasks.detail: Build with GCC and strict unused-result checking to mirror Linux CI environment

tasks.label: Configure Tests (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake -G Ninja -B build-tests -S tests -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/nix-toolchain.cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug'
tasks.detail: Configure test build with Nix dependencies

tasks.label: Build Tests (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake --build build-tests --parallel'
tasks.detail: Build all test executables using Nix

tasks.label: Run All Tests (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake --build build-tests --target run_all_tests'
tasks.detail: Run complete test suite (Google Test + Legacy tests) using Nix

tasks.label: Run Google Tests Only (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake --build build-tests --target run_gtest_only'
tasks.detail: Run Google Test suite only using Nix

tasks.label: Run Legacy Tests Only (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cmake --build build-tests --target run_legacy_tests'
tasks.detail: Run legacy console tests only using Nix

tasks.label: Run CTest (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cd build-tests && ctest --output-on-failure --verbose'
tasks.detail: Run tests through CTest framework using Nix

tasks.label: Run HTTP/SSL Tests (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cd build-tests && ./test_fetch_ssl'
tasks.detail: Run HTTP/SSL configuration tests using Nix

tasks.label: Run Math Operations Tests (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cd build-tests && ./test_math_operations'

tasks.label: Run Bybit Currency Tests (Nix)
tasks.command: nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --extra-experimental-features flakes develop -c bash -c 'cd build-tests && ./test_bybit_currency_fix'

tasks.label: Run SSL UI Mode Tests (Nix)
